label.en: Biography of Xu Huang · with Zhu Ling

title.zht: 魏書十七 · 徐晃傳 · 附朱靈
title.zhs: 魏书十七 · 徐晃传 · 附朱灵
title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 17 · Biography of Xu Huang · with Zhu Ling

text.en: Xu Huang earned merit and rank under Yang Feng, and persuaded him to escort the emperor back to Luoyang; when court infighting then led Xu Huang to urge Yang Feng to submit to Cao Cao, Yang Feng at first agreed but changed his mind, and Cao Cao's subsequent attack on him left Xu Huang going over to Cao Cao alone.
text.zht: 徐晃隨楊奉立功受爵，並勸楊奉護送天子還洛陽；後因朝中紛爭，徐晃又勸楊奉歸順曹操，楊奉本已答應卻又反悔，太祖遂討伐楊奉，徐晃轉而獨自投奔曹操。
text.zhs: 徐晃随杨奉立功受爵，并劝杨奉护送天子还洛阳；后因朝中纷争，徐晃又劝杨奉归顺曹操，杨奉本已答应却又反悔，太祖遂讨伐杨奉，徐晃转而独自投奔曹操。

text.en: When Yang Feng wavered over submitting to Cao Cao, Xu Huang went over to Cao Cao alone.
text.zht: 楊奉在歸順曹操一事上反覆，徐晃遂轉而獨自投奔曹操。
text.zhs: 杨奉在归顺曹操一事上反复，徐晃遂转而独自投奔曹操。

text.en: Given his own command, Xu Huang won a long string of victories for Cao Cao — against Lü Bu's generals, at Baima and Yanjin, and against Yuan Shao's supply lines — earning the greatest merit and enfeoffment as Capital Neighbourhood Marquis.
text.zht: 徐晃獲授兵權後屢立戰功——降呂布部將、克白馬延津、截袁紹糧道——以功勞最大獲封都亭侯。
text.zhs: 徐晃获授兵权后屡立战功——降吕布部将、克白马延津、截袁绍粮道——以功劳最大获封都亭侯。

text.en: At Yiyang, Xu Huang accepted a besieged garrison's surrender against Cao Cao's standing order and persuaded him that mercy here would encourage other cities to submit rather than fight to the death; Cao Cao agreed.
text.zht: 易陽之圍，徐晃違例接受守軍投降，並說服曹操寬待降者可使其他城池望風歸順而非死守；曹操從其言。
text.zhs: 易阳之围，徐晃违例接受守军投降，并说服曹操宽待降者可使其他城池望风归顺而非死守；曹操从其言。

text.en: At Tongguan, Xu Huang correctly judged that Han Sui and Ma Chao had left the Puban ford undefended, and led four thousand men across to outflank them at Cao Cao's approval.
text.zht: 潼關之役，徐晃準確判斷韓遂、馬超未派兵扼守蒲阪渡口，率四千人渡河奇襲，獲曹操採納。
text.zhs: 潼关之役，徐晃准确判断韩遂、马超未派兵扼守蒲阪渡口，率四千人渡河奇袭，获曹操采纳。

text.en: After Xu Huang alone routed Liu Bei's forces at the Mamingge plank road, Cao Cao was overjoyed, granted him the Imperial Tally, and declared it "the finest of fine achievements."
text.zht: 徐晃於馬鳴閣棧道獨力擊破劉備軍後，曹操大喜，授以節杖，稱其為「善之善者也」。
text.zhs: 徐晃于马鸣阁栈道独力击破刘备军后，曹操大喜，授以节杖，称其为「善之善者也」。

text.en: After Xu Huang drove into Guan Yu's siege lines and relieved Fancheng and Xiangyang, Cao Cao declared his feat unmatched in thirty years of campaigning, surpassing even Sun Wu and Rangju, went seven li out to welcome him with a banquet, and likened his unshaken discipline to that of the Han general Zhou Yafu.
text.zht: 徐晃攻破關羽包圍圈、解樊城與襄陽之圍後，曹操盛讚其功乃三十年用兵所未見，勝過孫武、穰苴，親出七里設宴相迎，並讚其軍紀嚴整有周亞夫之風。
text.zhs: 徐晃攻破关羽包围圈、解樊城与襄阳之围后，曹操盛赞其功乃三十年用兵所未见，胜过孙武、穰苴，亲出七里设宴相迎，并赞其军纪严整有周亚夫之风。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in the campaign against Lü Bu.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖征討呂布。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖征讨吕布。

text.en: Xu Huang independently secured the surrender of Lü Bu's general Zhao Shu.
text.zht: 徐晃單獨領兵迫使呂布部將趙庶投降。
text.zhs: 徐晃单独领兵迫使吕布部将赵庶投降。

text.en: Xu Huang independently secured the surrender of Lü Bu's general Li Zou.
text.zht: 徐晃單獨領兵迫使呂布部將李鄒投降。
text.zhs: 徐晃单独领兵迫使吕布部将李邹投降。

text.en: Xu Huang and Shi Huan jointly slew Sui Gu in Henei and later jointly raided Yuan Shao's supply wagons at Gushi.
text.zht: 徐晃與史渙合力於河內擊殺眭固，後又合力在故市截擊袁紹運糧車隊。
text.zhs: 徐晃与史涣合力于河内击杀眭固，后又合力在故市截击袁绍运粮车队。

text.en: Xu Huang and Shi Huan slew Sui Gu in Henei.
text.zht: 徐晃與史渙在河內擊殺眭固。
text.zhs: 徐晃与史涣在河内击杀眭固。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in defeating Liu Bei.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖擊敗劉備。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖击败刘备。

text.en: When Liu Bei sent Chen Shi to cut the Mamingge plank road into Hanzhong, Xu Huang routed them alone, prompting Cao Cao's highest praise.
text.zht: 劉備遣陳式斷絕通往漢中的馬鳴閣棧道，徐晃獨力擊破，獲曹操盛讚。
text.zhs: 刘备遣陈式断绝通往汉中的马鸣阁栈道，徐晃独力击破，获曹操盛赞。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Xiahou Shang in defeating Liu Bei's forces at Shangyong.
text.zht: 徐晃與夏侯尚在上庸擊破劉備軍。
text.zhs: 徐晃与夏侯尚在上庸击破刘备军。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in defeating Yan Liang and capturing Baima.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖擊敗顏良，攻克白馬。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖击败颜良，攻克白马。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in defeating Wen Chou at Yanjin.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖在延津擊敗文醜。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖在延津击败文丑。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Cao Hong in defeating the rebel Zhu Bi at Yinqiang.
text.zht: 徐晃與曹洪合力在㶏強擊破賊寇祝臂。
text.zhs: 徐晃与曹洪合力在㶏强击破贼寇祝臂。

text.en: Xu Huang and Shi Huan raided Yuan Shao's supply wagons at Gushi, earning the greatest merit in the campaign.
text.zht: 徐晃與史渙在故市截擊袁紹的運糧車隊，功勞最大。
text.zhs: 徐晃与史涣在故市截击袁绍的运粮车队，功劳最大。

text.en: Though Han Fan had feigned surrender and held out at Yiyang, Xu Huang accepted his eventual surrender against Cao Cao's standing order, arguing that mercy here would encourage other cities to submit peacefully — advice Cao Cao heeded.
text.zht: 韓範詐降據守易陽，徐晃仍違例接受其最終投降，並說服曹操此舉可使他城望風歸順，曹操從之。
text.zhs: 韩范诈降据守易阳，徐晃仍违例接受其最终投降，并说服曹操此举可使他城望风归顺，曹操从之。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in defeating Yuan Tan at Nanpi.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖在南皮擊敗袁譚。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖在南皮击败袁谭。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in the campaign against the Wuhuan chieftain Tadun.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖征討烏丸首領蹋頓。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖征讨乌丸首领蹋顿。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Man Chong in an early campaign against Guan Yu at Hanjin.
text.zht: 徐晃與滿寵在漢津合力征討關羽。
text.zhs: 徐晃与满宠在汉津合力征讨关羽。

text.en: Xu Huang and Man Chong campaigned against Guan Yu at Hanjin.
text.zht: 徐晃與滿寵在漢津征討關羽。
text.zhs: 徐晃与满宠在汉津征讨关羽。

text.en: At the siege of Fancheng, Xu Huang feinted at one camp while secretly striking another; when Guan Yu personally led out troops to save it, Xu Huang routed him and pursued the broken army into the Han River, drowning many.
text.zht: 樊城之圍，徐晃虛攻一營而暗襲另一營；關羽親率兵馬來救，徐晃擊退並追擊潰軍入漢水，敵軍多溺死。
text.zhs: 樊城之围，徐晃虚攻一营而暗袭另一营；关羽亲率兵马来救，徐晃击退并追击溃军入汉水，敌军多溺死。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Cao Ren in attacking Zhou Yu at Jiangling.
text.zht: 徐晃與曹仁在江陵合力攻擊周瑜。
text.zhs: 徐晃与曹仁在江陵合力攻击周瑜。

text.en: Xu Huang was sent to reinforce Cao Ren's defence against Guan Yu's siege of Fancheng.
text.zht: 徐晃奉遣協助曹仁抵禦關羽對樊城的圍攻。
text.zhs: 徐晃奉遣协助曹仁抵御关羽对樊城的围攻。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Cao Ren in attacking Zhou Yu at Jiangling.
text.zht: 徐晃與曹仁在江陵合力攻擊周瑜。
text.zhs: 徐晃与曹仁在江陵合力攻击周瑜。

text.en: Xu Huang besieged and captured Daling, beheading the rebel leader Shang Yao.
text.zht: 徐晃圍攻大陵並攻克之，斬殺叛軍首領商曜。
text.zhs: 徐晃围攻大陵并攻克之，斩杀叛军首领商曜。

text.en: When Han Sui and Ma Chao rebelled west of the Pass, Xu Huang's crossing at Puban outflanked them and let Cao Cao's army cross to defeat them.
text.zht: 韓遂、馬超於關右反叛，徐晃自蒲阪渡河奇襲，使太祖大軍得以渡河將其擊破。
text.zhs: 韩遂、马超于关右反叛，徐晃自蒲阪渡河奇袭，使太祖大军得以渡河将其击破。

text.en: Xu Huang's flanking crossing at Puban enabled Cao Cao's army to cross the river and defeat Ma Chao's forces.
text.zht: 徐晃自蒲阪渡河奇襲，使太祖大軍得以渡河擊破馬超軍。
text.zhs: 徐晃自蒲阪渡河奇袭，使太祖大军得以渡河击破马超军。

text.en: Liang Xing attacked Xu Huang's unfinished camp by night but was routed; Xu Huang later joined Xiahou Yuan in hunting him down and beheading him.
text.zht: 梁興夜襲徐晃未築成的營壘，反被擊退；徐晃後又與夏侯淵合力將其擒斬。
text.zhs: 梁兴夜袭徐晃未筑成的营垒，反被击退；徐晃后又与夏侯渊合力将其擒斩。

text.en: Xu Huang and Xiahou Yuan jointly pacified the Di tribes and hunted down Liang Xing together.
text.zht: 徐晃與夏侯淵合力平定氐族部落，並一同擒斬梁興。
text.zhs: 徐晃与夏侯渊合力平定氐族部落，并一同擒斩梁兴。

text.en: Xu Huang and Xiahou Yuan were jointly left to resist Liu Bei at Yangpingguan.
text.zht: 徐晃與夏侯淵同守陽平關抵禦劉備。
text.zhs: 徐晃与夏侯渊同守阳平关抵御刘备。

text.en: Xu Huang took part in the campaign against Zhang Lu.
text.zht: 徐晃隨太祖征討張魯。
text.zhs: 徐晃随太祖征讨张鲁。

text.en: Xu Huang relieved General Zhang Shun from a siege.
text.zht: 徐晃出兵解救被圍困的將軍張順。
text.zhs: 徐晃出兵解救被围困的将军张顺。

text.en: Xu Huang attacked and destroyed more than thirty camps held by the rebel Chen Fu and others.
text.zht: 徐晃攻破賊寇陳福等人三十餘座營寨。
text.zhs: 徐晃攻破贼寇陈福等人三十余座营寨。

text.en: When Chen Shi and more than ten encampments tried to cut the Mamingge plank road, Xu Huang alone routed them, and many enemy soldiers died fleeing into the ravines.
text.zht: 陳式率十餘營欲斷馬鳴閣棧道，徐晃獨力將其擊破，敵軍潰逃入山谷者多死。
text.zhs: 陈式率十余营欲断马鸣阁栈道，徐晃独力将其击破，敌军溃逃入山谷者多死。

text.en: While Xu Huang moved to relieve Fancheng, Guan Yu was simultaneously besieging General Lü Chang at Xiangyang.
text.zht: 徐晃赴援樊城之際，關羽同時圍困將軍呂常於襄陽。
text.zhs: 徐晃赴援樊城之际，关羽同时围困将军吕常于襄阳。

text.en: Xu Huang joined Xiahou Shang in defeating Liu Bei's forces at Shangyong.
text.zht: 徐晃與夏侯尚在上庸合力擊破劉備軍。
text.zhs: 徐晃与夏侯尚在上庸合力击破刘备军。

text.en: When Emperor Ming came to the throne, Xu Huang repelled the Wu general Zhuge Jin at Xiangyang.
text.zht: 明帝即位後，徐晃在襄陽抵禦吳將諸葛瑾。
text.zhs: 明帝即位后，徐晃在襄阳抵御吴将诸葛瑾。

text.en: Xu Huang's son Xu Gai succeeded him as marquis.
text.zht: 徐晃之子徐蓋襲爵。
text.zhs: 徐晃之子徐盖袭爵。

text.en: After Xu Gai's death, his son Xu Ba succeeded him.
text.zht: 徐蓋去世後，其子徐霸襲爵。
text.zhs: 徐盖去世后，其子徐霸袭爵。

text.en: Zhu Ling served as a general under Yuan Shao and earned merit commanding three encampments sent to aid Cao Cao's campaign against Tao Qian.
text.zht: 朱靈初為袁紹部將，曾統三營助太祖征討陶謙而立功。
text.zhs: 朱灵初为袁绍部将，曾统三营助太祖征讨陶谦而立功。

text.en: When Yuan Shao's other generals returned home after the campaign, Zhu Ling declared none compared to Lord Cao and chose to remain in his service, taking his admiring troops with him.
text.zht: 袁紹所遣諸將戰後各自歸還，朱靈獨稱無人可比曹公，遂留而不去，所部士卒亦皆相隨。
text.zhs: 袁绍所遣诸将战后各自归还，朱灵独称无人可比曹公，遂留而不去，所部士卒亦皆相随。

text.en: After Zhu Ling executed the mutinous Cheng Ang and wrote in guilt-ridden remorse, Cao Cao personally reassured him, citing the Han general Deng Yu's own setback as proof that one reversal need not diminish a commander's reputation.
text.zht: 朱靈斬殺叛變的程昂後，來信深自引咎，太祖親筆寬慰，舉東漢鄧禹曾遭挫敗為例，說明一時失利無損將領名譽。
text.zhs: 朱灵斩杀叛变的程昂后，来信深自引咎，太祖亲笔宽慰，举东汉邓禹曾遭挫败为例，说明一时失利无损将领名誉。

text.en: On ascending the throne, Cao Pi issued a lavish edict praising Zhu Ling's decades of service as surpassing famous ministers of old, enfeoffed him Marquis of Shu, and — learning his one wish was to be enfeoffed in his native Gaotang instead — granted it.
text.zht: 曹丕即位後頒詔盛讚朱靈多年戎馬之功超越古之名臣，封其為鄃侯；得知朱靈素願改封故鄉高唐，即予以改封。
text.zhs: 曹丕即位后颁诏盛赞朱灵多年戎马之功超越古之名臣，封其为鄃侯；得知朱灵素愿改封故乡高唐，即予以改封。

text.en: Yuan Shao sent Zhu Ling to command three encampments aiding Cao Cao's campaign against Tao Qian.
text.zht: 袁紹派朱靈統三營助太祖征討陶謙。
text.zhs: 袁绍派朱灵统三营助太祖征讨陶谦。

text.en: Yuan Shao sent Zhu Ling to attack Ji Yong, who had rebelled and surrendered the city of Shu to Gongsun Zan; Zhu Ling fought his way in and captured Ji Yong alive.
text.zht: 季雍以鄃城叛袁紹降公孫瓚，袁紹遣朱靈攻之；朱靈力戰破城，生擒季雍。
text.zhs: 季雍以鄃城叛袁绍降公孙瓒，袁绍遣朱灵攻之；朱灵力战破城，生擒季雍。

text.en: To sway Zhu Ling from besieging Shu, Gongsun Zan placed his mother and younger brother atop the city wall and called out to him; Zhu Ling wept but fought on regardless, and his family died in the city's fall.
text.zht: 公孫瓚為動搖攻城的朱靈，將其母弟置於城牆之上呼喚誘勸；朱靈望城涕泣仍奮力攻城，其家人終於城破時盡死。
text.zhs: 公孙瓒为动摇攻城的朱灵，将其母弟置于城墙之上呼唤诱劝；朱灵望城涕泣仍奋力攻城，其家人终于城破时尽死。

text.en: When the Gentleman-General Cheng Ang mutinied among the new Ji Province recruits under his command, Zhu Ling swiftly beheaded him.
text.zht: 中郎將程昂在朱靈所統冀州新兵中反叛，朱靈即斬之。
text.zhs: 中郎将程昂在朱灵所统冀州新兵中反叛，朱灵即斩之。

text.en: After Zhu Ling's death, his son Zhu Shu succeeded him as marquis.
text.zht: 朱靈去世後，其子朱術襲爵。
text.zhs: 朱灵去世后，其子朱术袭爵。

orig.zht: 徐晃字公明，[[河東楊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]人也。為郡吏，從[[車騎將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-grand-generals-037]]楊奉討賊有功，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。李傕、郭汜之亂[[長安|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.31264639&lng=108.87167209&name=Chang%27an]]也，晃說奉，令與天子還[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，奉從其計。天子渡河至[[安邑|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.16855789&lng=111.14855723&name=Anyi]]，封晃[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。及到[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，韓暹、董承日爭鬬，晃說奉令歸太祖；奉欲從之，後悔。太祖討奉於[[梁|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.16060618&lng=112.77664557&name=Liang]]，晃遂歸太祖。
orig.zhs: 徐晃字公明，[[河东杨|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]人也。为郡吏，从[[车骑将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-grand-generals-037]]杨奉讨贼有功，[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。李傕、郭汜之乱[[长安|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.31264639&lng=108.87167209&name=Chang%27an]]也，晃说奉，令与天子还[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，奉从其计。天子渡河至[[安邑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.16855789&lng=111.14855723&name=Anyi]]，封晃[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。及到[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，韩暹、董承日争鬬，晃说奉令归太祖；奉欲从之，后悔。太祖讨奉于[[梁|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.16060618&lng=112.77664557&name=Liang]]，晃遂归太祖。

vern.zht: 徐晃，字公明，[[河東郡楊縣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]人。他擔任郡吏，跟隨[[車騎將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-grand-generals-037]]楊奉討伐賊寇有功，被任命爲[[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。李傕、郭汜在[[長安|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.31264639&lng=108.87167209&name=Chang%27an]]作亂時，徐晃勸說楊奉，讓楊奉和天子返回[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，楊奉聽從了他的計策。天子渡過黃河到達[[安邑|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.16855789&lng=111.14855723&name=Anyi]]，封徐晃爲[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。等天子到了[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，韓暹、董承每天爭鬥，徐晃勸說楊奉，讓楊奉歸附太祖；楊奉本想聽從，事後又反悔。太祖在[[梁|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.16060618&lng=112.77664557&name=Liang]]地討伐楊奉，徐晃於是歸附太祖。
vern.zhs: 徐晃，字公明，[[河东郡杨县|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]人。他担任郡吏，跟随[[车骑将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-grand-generals-037]]杨奉讨伐贼寇有功，被任命为[[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。李傕、郭汜在[[长安|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.31264639&lng=108.87167209&name=Chang%27an]]作乱时，徐晃劝说杨奉，让杨奉和天子返回[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，杨奉听从了他的计策。天子渡过黄河到达[[安邑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.16855789&lng=111.14855723&name=Anyi]]，封徐晃为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。等天子到了[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，韩暹、董承每天争斗，徐晃劝说杨奉，让杨奉归附太祖；杨奉本想听从，事后又反悔。太祖在[[梁|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.16060618&lng=112.77664557&name=Liang]]地讨伐杨奉，徐晃于是归附太祖。

passages.en: Xu Huang, courtesy name Gongming, was from [[Yang, Hedong|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]. He served as a commandery clerk and followed [[General of Chariots and Cavalry|/translations/officials/military#various-grand-generals-037]] Yang Feng in suppressing rebels. Having earned merit, he was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]. During the turmoil caused by Li Jue and Guo Si in [[Chang'an|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.31264639&lng=108.87167209&name=Chang%27an]], Xu Huang urged Yang Feng to escort the emperor back to [[Luoyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]], and Yang Feng adopted his plan. After the emperor crossed the Yellow River and reached [[Anyi|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.16855789&lng=111.14855723&name=Anyi]], Xu Huang was enfeoffed as [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]. Upon their arrival in [[Luoyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]], Han Xian and Dong Cheng fought daily. Xu Huang urged Yang Feng to go over to Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor). Yang Feng intended to follow his advice, but later changed his mind. When Cao Cao attacked Yang Feng at [[Liang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.16060618&lng=112.77664557&name=Liang]], Xu Huang went over to Cao Cao.

vern.zht: 太祖撥給徐晃軍隊，派他去攻打[[卷|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.03134233&lng=113.72992008&name=Juan]]、[[原武|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.04215228&lng=113.97018459&name=Yuanwu]]的賊寇；徐晃擊敗了他們，被任命爲[[裨將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-165]]。徐晃隨太祖征討呂布，另率兵降服呂布部將趙庶、李鄒等人。徐晃與史渙在[[河內|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]斬殺了眭固。徐晃隨太祖擊破劉備，又隨太祖擊破顏良，攻佔[[白馬|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.56235226&lng=114.65338913&name=Baima]]，進抵[[延津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.3722844&lng=114.28754783&name=Yanjin]]，擊破文丑，被任命爲[[偏將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]。徐晃與曹洪攻打[[㶏強|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.78352783&lng=114.09432439&name=㶏強]]的賊寇祝臂，擊敗了他們；又與史渙在[[故市|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.79738574&lng=113.47134429&name=Gushi]]攻擊袁紹的運輸車輛，功勞最多，被封爲[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。太祖包圍[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]城、攻破[[邯鄲|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.59621665&lng=114.46620323&name=Handan]]後，[[易陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]令韓範假意獻城投降，卻據城堅守，太祖派徐晃去攻打他。
vern.zhs: 太祖拨给徐晃军队，派他去攻打[[卷|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.03134233&lng=113.72992008&name=Juan]]、[[原武|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.04215228&lng=113.97018459&name=Yuanwu]]的贼寇；徐晃击败了他们，被任命为[[裨将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-165]]。徐晃随太祖征讨吕布，另率兵降服吕布部将赵庶、李邹等人。徐晃与史涣在[[河内|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]斩杀了眭固。徐晃随太祖击破刘备，又随太祖击破颜良，攻占[[白马|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.56235226&lng=114.65338913&name=Baima]]，进抵[[延津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.3722844&lng=114.28754783&name=Yanjin]]，击破文丑，被任命为[[偏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]。徐晃与曹洪攻打[[㶏强|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.78352783&lng=114.09432439&name=㶏強]]的贼寇祝臂，击败了他们；又与史涣在[[故市|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.79738574&lng=113.47134429&name=Gushi]]攻击袁绍的运输车辆，功劳最多，被封为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。太祖包围[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]城、攻破[[邯郸|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.59621665&lng=114.46620323&name=Handan]]后，[[易阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]令韩范假意献城投降，却据城坚守，太祖派徐晃去攻打他。

passages.en: Cao Cao gave Xu Huang troops and sent him against the bandits at [[Juan|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.03134233&lng=113.72992008&name=Juan]] and [[Yuanwu|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.04215228&lng=113.97018459&name=Yuanwu]]. After defeating them, Xu Huang was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Assistant General|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-165]]. He took part in the campaign against Lü Bu, separately securing the surrender of Lü Bu's generals Zhao Shu, Li Zou, and others. Together with Shi Huan, he slew Sui Gu in [[Henei|/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]. Xu Huang then helped defeat Liu Bei and Yan Liang, captured [[Baima|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.56235226&lng=114.65338913&name=Baima]], advanced to [[Yanjin|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.3722844&lng=114.28754783&name=Yanjin]], and defeated Wen Chou. He was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Adjunct General|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]. Later, Xu Huang and Cao Hong defeated the rebel Zhu Bi at [[Yinqiang|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.78352783&lng=114.09432439&name=㶏強]]. He then joined Shi Huan in attacking Yuan Shao's supply wagons at [[Gushi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.79738574&lng=113.47134429&name=Gushi]], where he earned the greatest merit, and was enfeoffed as [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]. After Cao Cao had laid siege to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]] and taken [[Handan|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.59621665&lng=114.46620323&name=Handan]], Han Fan, Magistrate of [[Yiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]], feigned surrender but continued to hold the city. Cao Cao sent Xu Huang to attack him.

annotations.en: [[Juan|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.03134233&lng=113.72992008&name=Juan]] is pronounced according to the fanqie spelling xu-quan.

orig.zht: 晃至，飛矢城中，為陳成敗。範悔，晃輙降之。旣而言於太祖曰：「二袁未破，諸城未下者傾耳而聽，今日滅[[易陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]，明日皆以死守，恐河北無定時也。願公降[[易陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]以示諸城，則莫不望風。」太祖善之。別討毛城，設伏兵掩擊，破三屯。從破袁譚於[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，討[[平原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=37.05824816&lng=116.3832756&name=Pingyuan]]叛賊，克之。從征蹋頓，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]]橫野將軍。從征[[荊州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]，別屯[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，討[[中廬|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.93854784&lng=112.06649019&name=Zhonglu]]、[[臨沮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.18934355&lng=111.53402839&name=Linju]]、[[宜城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.66663671&lng=112.29180382&name=Yicheng]]賊。又與滿寵討關羽於漢津，與曹仁擊周瑜於[[江陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=30.34078806&lng=112.18710173&name=Jiangling]]。

vern.zht: 徐晃到達後，把陳說成敗利害的書信射進城中。韓範後悔了，徐晃隨即降服了他。之後徐晃對太祖說：“二袁還未被擊破，尚未攻下的各城都在傾耳傾聽；今天滅了[[易陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]，明天它們就都會拼死堅守，恐怕河北就沒有安定的時候了。希望您讓[[易陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]歸降，以此昭示各城，那麼就沒有不望風歸順的了。”太祖認爲他說得對。徐晃另外討伐毛城，設下伏兵突襲，攻破三處營壘。跟隨太祖在[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]擊破袁譚，討伐[[平原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=37.05824816&lng=116.3832756&name=Pingyuan]]叛賊，並將其攻克。跟隨太祖征討蹋頓，被任命爲橫野將軍。跟隨太祖征討[[荊州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]，另屯駐於[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，討伐[[中廬|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.93854784&lng=112.06649019&name=Zhonglu]]、[[臨沮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.18934355&lng=111.53402839&name=Linju]]、[[宜城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.66663671&lng=112.29180382&name=Yicheng]]的賊寇。又和滿寵在漢津討伐關羽，和曹仁在[[江陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=30.34078806&lng=112.18710173&name=Jiangling]]攻擊周瑜。
vern.zhs: 徐晃到达后，把陈说成败利害的书信射进城中。韩范后悔了，徐晃随即降服了他。之后徐晃对太祖说：“二袁还未被击破，尚未攻下的各城都在倾耳倾听；今天灭了[[易阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]，明天它们就都会拼死坚守，恐怕河北就没有安定的时候了。希望您让[[易阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]归降，以此昭示各城，那么就没有不望风归顺的了。”太祖认为他说得对。徐晃另外讨伐毛城，设下伏兵突袭，攻破三处营垒。跟随太祖在[[南皮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]击破袁谭，讨伐[[平原|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=37.05824816&lng=116.3832756&name=Pingyuan]]叛贼，并将其攻克。跟随太祖征讨蹋顿，被任命为横野将军。跟随太祖征讨[[荆州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]，另屯驻于[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，讨伐[[中庐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.93854784&lng=112.06649019&name=Zhonglu]]、[[临沮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.18934355&lng=111.53402839&name=Linju]]、[[宜城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.66663671&lng=112.29180382&name=Yicheng]]的贼寇。又和满宠在汉津讨伐关羽，和曹仁在[[江陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=30.34078806&lng=112.18710173&name=Jiangling]]攻击周瑜。

passages.en: When Xu Huang arrived, he shot a letter into the city on an arrow, setting out the consequences of success and failure. Han Fan regretted his resistance, and Xu Huang promptly accepted his surrender. He then said to Cao Cao, "The two Yuans have yet to be defeated, and the cities that have not submitted are listening closely. If [[Yiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]] is destroyed today, tomorrow they will all resolve to defend themselves to the death, and I fear the lands north of the Yellow River will not be pacified. I urge you, my lord, to accept [[Yiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.71417381&lng=114.62937544&name=Yiyang]]'s surrender and thereby encourage the other cities. When word spreads, they will surely submit." Cao Cao approved of his words. Xu Huang then separately attacked Maocheng. He laid an ambush, launched a surprise attack, and broke three encampments. He later accompanied Cao Cao in defeating Yuan Tan at [[Nanpi|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]], and subdued the rebels in [[Pingyuan|/maps/map-overall?lat=37.05824816&lng=116.3832756&name=Pingyuan]]. Thereafter, Xu Huang took part in the campaign against Tadun and was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] General Who Sweeps Across the Wilderness. He also joined the expedition against [[Jing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=2]], where he separately garrisoned at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] and suppressed the rebels at [[Zhonglu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.93854784&lng=112.06649019&name=Zhonglu]], [[Linju|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.18934355&lng=111.53402839&name=Linju]], and [[Yicheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.66663671&lng=112.29180382&name=Yicheng]]. He then joined Man Chong in attacking Guan Yu at Hanjin, and Cao Ren in attacking Zhou Yu at [[Jiangling|/maps/map-overall?lat=30.34078806&lng=112.18710173&name=Jiangling]].

orig.zht: 十五年，討[[太原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]反者，圍[[大陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=37.49238085&lng=112.09933191&name=Daling]]，拔之，斬賊帥商曜。韓遂、馬超等反[[關右|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]，遣晃屯[[汾陰|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.36816293&lng=110.51564591&name=Fenyin]]以撫[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，賜牛酒，令上先人墓。太祖至[[潼關|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.59426174&lng=110.32268475&name=Tongguan]]，恐不得渡，召問晃。晃曰：「公盛兵於此，而賊不復別守[[蒲阪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=Puban]]，知其無謀也。今假臣精兵[[蒲阪津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]，為軍先置，以截其裏，賊可擒也。」太祖曰：「善。」使晃以步騎四千人渡津。
orig.zhs: 十五年，讨[[太原|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]反者，围[[大陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=37.49238085&lng=112.09933191&name=Daling]]，拔之，斩贼帅商曜。韩遂、马超等反[[关右|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]，遣晃屯[[汾阴|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.36816293&lng=110.51564591&name=Fenyin]]以抚[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，赐牛酒，令上先人墓。太祖至[[潼关|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.59426174&lng=110.32268475&name=Tongguan]]，恐不得渡，召问晃。晃曰：「公盛兵于此，而贼不复别守[[蒲阪|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=Puban]]，知其无谋也。今假臣精兵[[蒲阪津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]，为军先置，以截其里，贼可擒也。」太祖曰：「善。」使晃以步骑四千人渡津。

vern.zht: 十五年，徐晃討伐[[太原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]的反叛者，包圍[[大陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=37.49238085&lng=112.09933191&name=Daling]]，攻克該城，斬殺了賊軍首領商曜。韓遂、馬超等人在[[關右|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]反叛，太祖派徐晃駐守[[汾陰|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.36816293&lng=110.51564591&name=Fenyin]]以安撫[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，賜給他牛和酒，命他爲先人上墳。太祖到達[[潼關|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.59426174&lng=110.32268475&name=Tongguan]]，擔心無法渡過去，召來徐晃詢問。徐晃說：“明公您在這裏集結重兵，而敵人不再另外分兵把守[[蒲阪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=Puban]]，可見他們沒有謀略。現在請給我一支精兵，從[[蒲阪津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]渡河，充當全軍的先頭部隊，以截斷敵人的後路，敵軍就可以被擒獲。”太祖說：“好。”派徐晃率領步兵、騎兵四千人渡過[[蒲阪津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]。
vern.zhs: 十五年，徐晃讨伐[[太原|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]的反叛者，包围[[大陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=37.49238085&lng=112.09933191&name=Daling]]，攻克该城，斩杀了贼军首领商曜。韩遂、马超等人在[[关右|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]反叛，太祖派徐晃驻守[[汾阴|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.36816293&lng=110.51564591&name=Fenyin]]以安抚[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，赐给他牛和酒，命他为先人上坟。太祖到达[[潼关|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.59426174&lng=110.32268475&name=Tongguan]]，担心无法渡过去，召来徐晃询问。徐晃说：“明公您在这里集结重兵，而敌人不再另外分兵把守[[蒲阪|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=Puban]]，可见他们没有谋略。现在请给我一支精兵，从[[蒲阪津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]渡河，充当全军的先头部队，以截断敌人的后路，敌军就可以被擒获。”太祖说：“好。”派徐晃率领步兵、骑兵四千人渡过[[蒲阪津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]]。

passages.en: In the fifteenth year of Jian'an, Xu Huang campaigned against the rebels in [[Taiyuan|/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]. He besieged and captured [[Daling|/maps/map-overall?lat=37.49238085&lng=112.09933191&name=Daling]], and beheaded the rebel leader Shang Yao. When Han Sui, Ma Chao, and others rebelled [[West of the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]], Xu Huang was sent to garrison [[Fenyin|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.36816293&lng=110.51564591&name=Fenyin]] and pacify [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]. He was granted oxen and wine and ordered to pay respects at his ancestors' graves. When Cao Cao reached [[Tongguan|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.59426174&lng=110.32268475&name=Tongguan]], he feared that he would be unable to cross the river and summoned Xu Huang for his counsel. Xu Huang said, "My lord, you have concentrated a great army here, yet the enemy has sent no force to guard [[Puban|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=Puban]]. This shows that they are without a plan. Entrust your servant with elite troops, and I shall cross at [[Pubanjin|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.87374888&lng=110.28348954&name=Pubanjin]] and secure an advance position for the army, cutting off the enemy's rear. We can then capture them." "Excellent," said Cao Cao, and he ordered Xu Huang to cross at the ford with four thousand infantry and cavalry.

orig.zht: 作塹柵未成，賊梁興夜將步騎五千餘人攻晃，晃擊走之，太祖軍得渡。遂破超等，使晃與夏侯淵平[[隃麋|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.63936227&lng=107.17845258&name=Yumi]]、[[汧|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.83685651&lng=106.85666136&name=Qian]]諸氐，與太祖會[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]。太祖還[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，使晃與夏侯淵平[[鄜|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]、[[夏陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]]餘賊，斬梁興，降三千餘戶。從征張魯。別遣晃討攻櫝、仇夷諸山氐，皆降之。[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[平寇將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-124]]。解將軍張順圍。擊賊陳福等三十餘屯，皆破之。
orig.zhs: 作堑栅未成，贼梁兴夜将步骑五千余人攻晃，晃击走之，太祖军得渡。遂破超等，使晃与夏侯渊平[[隃麋|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.63936227&lng=107.17845258&name=Yumi]]、[[汧|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.83685651&lng=106.85666136&name=Qian]]诸氐，与太祖会[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]。太祖还[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，使晃与夏侯渊平[[鄜|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]、[[夏阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]]余贼，斩梁兴，降三千余户。从征张鲁。别遣晃讨攻椟、仇夷诸山氐，皆降之。[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[平寇将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-124]]。解将军张顺围。击贼陈福等三十余屯，皆破之。

vern.zht: 壕溝柵欄還未修成，賊人梁興趁夜率領步兵騎兵五千餘人進攻徐晃，徐晃擊退了他們，太祖的軍隊得以渡河。太祖於是擊破馬超等人，派徐晃與夏侯淵平定[[隃麋|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.63936227&lng=107.17845258&name=Yumi]]、[[汧|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.83685651&lng=106.85666136&name=Qian]]一帶的氐人，他們與太祖在[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]會合。太祖回到[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，又派徐晃與夏侯淵平定[[鄜|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]、[[夏陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]]的殘餘賊寇，斬殺梁興，使三千餘戶歸降。徐晃隨從太祖征討張魯。太祖又另外派徐晃攻討櫝、仇夷各山中的氐人，徐晃都使他們降服了。徐晃升任[[平寇將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-124]]，爲將軍張順解了圍，又攻擊賊人陳福等的三十餘處屯營，全部擊破。
vern.zhs: 壕沟栅栏还未修成，贼人梁兴趁夜率领步兵骑兵五千余人进攻徐晃，徐晃击退了他们，太祖的军队得以渡河。太祖于是击破马超等人，派徐晃与夏侯渊平定[[隃麋|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.63936227&lng=107.17845258&name=Yumi]]、[[汧|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.83685651&lng=106.85666136&name=Qian]]一带的氐人，他们与太祖在[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]会合。太祖回到[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，又派徐晃与夏侯渊平定[[鄜|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]、[[夏阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]]的残余贼寇，斩杀梁兴，使三千余户归降。徐晃随从太祖征讨张鲁。太祖又另外派徐晃攻讨椟、仇夷各山中的氐人，徐晃都使他们降服了。徐晃升任[[平寇将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-124]]，为将军张顺解了围，又攻击贼人陈福等的三十余处屯营，全部击破。

passages.en: Before the trenches and palisades were complete, Liang Xing led more than five thousand infantry and cavalry in a night attack on Xu Huang. Xu Huang routed them, enabling Cao Cao's army to cross. Cao Cao then defeated Ma Chao and his allies, and ordered Xu Huang and Xiahou Yuan to pacify the Di at [[Yumi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.63936227&lng=107.17845258&name=Yumi]] and [[Qian|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.83685651&lng=106.85666136&name=Qian]] before joining him at [[Anding|/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]. When Cao Cao returned to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]], he sent Xu Huang and Xiahou Yuan to suppress the remaining bandits at [[Fucheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]] and [[Xiayang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]]. They killed Liang Xing and received the surrender of more than three thousand households. Thereafter, Xu Huang took part in the campaign against Zhang Lu. He was then sent separately to campaign against the mountain Di at Gongdu and Qiuyi, all of whom surrendered. He was [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[General Who Subdues the Bandits|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-124]]. Later, Xu Huang relieved General Zhang Shun from a siege, then attacked and destroyed more than thirty camps held by Chen Fu and other rebels.

orig.zht: 太祖還[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，留晃與夏侯淵拒劉備於[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]。備遣陳式等十餘營絕[[馬鳴閣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.56081766&lng=105.77447206&name=Mamingge]]道，晃別征破之，賊自投山谷，多死者。太祖聞，甚喜，[[假晃節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，令曰：「此閣道，[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]之險要咽喉也。劉備欲斷絕外內，以取[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]。將軍一舉，克奪賊計，善之善者也。」太祖遂自至[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，引出[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]諸軍。復遣晃助曹仁討關羽，屯[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]。會[[漢水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴隘，于禁等沒。羽圍仁於[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，又圍將軍呂常於[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]]。晃所將多新卒，以羽難與爭鋒，遂前至陽陵陂屯。[^1]
orig.zhs: 太祖还[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，留晃与夏侯渊拒刘备于[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]。备遣陈式等十余营绝[[马鸣阁|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.56081766&lng=105.77447206&name=Mamingge]]道，晃别征破之，贼自投山谷，多死者。太祖闻，甚喜，[[假晃节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，令曰：「此阁道，[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]之险要咽喉也。刘备欲断绝外内，以取[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]。将军一举，克夺贼计，善之善者也。」太祖遂自至[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，引出[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]诸军。复遣晃助曹仁讨关羽，屯[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]。会[[汉水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴隘，于禁等没。羽围仁于[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，又围将军吕常于[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]]。晃所将多新卒，以羽难与争锋，遂前至阳陵陂屯。[^1]

vern.zht: 太祖回到[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，留下徐晃與夏侯淵在[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]抵禦劉備。劉備派陳式等十多營人馬斷絕了[[馬鳴閣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.56081766&lng=105.77447206&name=Mamingge]]道，徐晃另行征討，擊敗了他們；賊軍自己跳入山谷，死了很多。太祖聽說後，非常高興，授予徐晃[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，下令說：“這條閣道，是[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]的險要咽喉。劉備想斷絕內外聯繫，以奪取[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]。將軍一次行動，就粉碎了賊人的計謀，真是好中之好啊。”太祖於是親自來到[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，帶領[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]各軍撤出。又派徐晃協助曹仁討伐關羽，屯駐在[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]。正逢[[漢水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴漲，于禁等人的部隊被淹沒。關羽在[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]圍攻曹仁，又在[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]]圍攻將軍呂常。徐晃所率領的大多是新兵，認爲難以與關羽爭鋒，於是向前到達陽陵陂屯駐。[^1]
vern.zhs: 太祖回到[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，留下徐晃与夏侯渊在[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]抵御刘备。刘备派陈式等十多营人马断绝了[[马鸣阁|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.56081766&lng=105.77447206&name=Mamingge]]道，徐晃另行征讨，击败了他们；贼军自己跳入山谷，死了很多。太祖听说后，非常高兴，授予徐晃[[假节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，下令说：“这条阁道，是[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]的险要咽喉。刘备想断绝内外联系，以夺取[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]。将军一次行动，就粉碎了贼人的计谋，真是好中之好啊。”太祖于是亲自来到[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，带领[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]各军撤出。又派徐晃协助曹仁讨伐关羽，屯驻在[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]。正逢[[汉水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴涨，于禁等人的部队被淹没。关羽在[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]围攻曹仁，又在[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]]围攻将军吕常。徐晃所率领的大多是新兵，认为难以与关羽争锋，于是向前到达阳陵陂屯驻。[^1]

passages.en: When Cao Cao returned to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]], he left Xu Huang and Xiahou Yuan to resist Liu Bei at [[Yangpingguan|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]. Liu Bei sent Chen Shi and others with more than ten encampments to cut the [[Mamingge|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.56081766&lng=105.77447206&name=Mamingge]] roads. Xu Huang attacked them separately and routed them. Many enemy soldiers threw themselves into the mountain ravines and died. When Cao Cao heard of this, he was greatly pleased. He appointed Xu Huang [[Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally|/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]] and issued an order: "This plank road is the strategic throat of [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]. Liu Bei sought to sever all communication between the interior and the outside, and thus seize [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]. In a single stroke, the General has thwarted the enemy's design. No achievement could be finer." Cao Cao then went in person to [[Yangpingguan|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]] and led the armies to withdraw from [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]. Some time after, Cao Cao sent Xu Huang to aid Cao Ren in the campaign against Guan Yu, and Xu Huang garrisoned at [[Wan|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]. Around this time, the [[Han River|/maps/map-overall?water=52]] flooded suddenly, engulfing Yu Jin and the others. Guan Yu besieged Cao Ren at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] and General Lü Chang at [[Xiangyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]]. Most of Xu Huang's men were fresh recruits, and could not yet withstand Guan Yu's strength. Xu Huang therefore relocated to Yanglingbei and encamped there instead.[^1]

orig.zht: 太祖復還，遣將軍徐商、呂建等詣晃，令曰：「須兵馬集至，乃俱前。」賊屯偃城[^1]。晃到，詭道作都塹，示欲截其後，賊燒屯走。晃得偃城，兩面連營，稍前，去賊圍三[[丈|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]所。未攻，太祖前後遣殷署、朱蓋等凡十二營詣晃。賊圍頭有屯，又別屯四冢[^1]。晃揚聲當攻圍頭屯，而密攻四冢。羽見四冢欲壞，自將步騎五千出戰，晃擊之，退走，遂追陷與俱入圍，破之，或自投[[沔水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=51]]死。
orig.zhs: 太祖复还，遣将军徐商、吕建等诣晃，令曰：「须兵马集至，乃俱前。」贼屯偃城[^1]。晃到，诡道作都堑，示欲截其后，贼烧屯走。晃得偃城，两面连营，稍前，去贼围三[[丈|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]所。未攻，太祖前后遣殷署、朱盖等凡十二营诣晃。贼围头有屯，又别屯四冢[^1]。晃扬声当攻围头屯，而密攻四冢。羽见四冢欲坏，自将步骑五千出战，晃击之，退走，遂追陷与俱入围，破之，或自投[[沔水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=51]]死。

vern.zht: 太祖又返回，派將軍徐商、呂建等人到徐晃那裏，下令說：“必須等兵馬集中到齊，才能一同向前。”敵軍駐紮在偃城[^1]。徐晃到後，從隱蔽的小路過去，挖掘大壕溝，做出要截斷敵軍後路的樣子；敵軍燒掉營寨逃跑。徐晃佔領偃城，把兩面營寨連接起來，逐漸向前推進，距離敵軍的包圍圈三[[丈|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]左右。還沒有進攻，太祖先後派殷署、朱蓋等共十二營兵馬到徐晃那裏。敵軍包圍圈前部有營壘，又另在四冢駐有營壘[^1]。徐晃揚言要攻打包圍圈前部的營壘，卻祕密攻打四冢。關羽見四冢即將被攻破，親自率領步兵、騎兵五千人出戰；徐晃迎擊，關羽退走；徐晃於是乘勝追擊，隨着敗兵一起衝入其包圍圈，大破敵軍，有的敵兵跳入[[沔水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=51]]而死。
vern.zhs: 太祖又返回，派将军徐商、吕建等人到徐晃那里，下令说：“必须等兵马集中到齐，才能一同向前。”敌军驻扎在偃城[^1]。徐晃到后，从隐蔽的小路过去，挖掘大壕沟，做出要截断敌军后路的样子；敌军烧掉营寨逃跑。徐晃占领偃城，把两面营寨连接起来，逐渐向前推进，距离敌军的包围圈三[[丈|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]左右。还没有进攻，太祖先后派殷署、朱盖等共十二营兵马到徐晃那里。敌军包围圈前部有营垒，又另在四冢驻有营垒[^1]。徐晃扬言要攻打包围圈前部的营垒，却秘密攻打四冢。关羽见四冢即将被攻破，亲自率领步兵、骑兵五千人出战；徐晃迎击，关羽退走；徐晃于是乘胜追击，随着败兵一起冲入其包围圈，大破敌军，有的敌兵跳入[[沔水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=51]]而死。

passages.en: When Cao Cao returned, he sent the generals Xu Shang, Lü Jian, and others to Xu Huang with orders: "Wait until all the troops and cavalry have assembled, then advance together." The enemy was encamped at Yancheng[^1]. On arriving, Xu Huang used a ruse, digging a long trench as if to cut off their rear. The enemy then burnt their camp and fled. Xu Huang took Yancheng, established a chain of camps on either side, and gradually advanced to within some three [[zhang|/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]] of the enemy's siege lines. Before the attack, Cao Cao sent Yin Shu, Zhu Gai, and others to reinforce him with a total of twelve encampments. The enemy had a camp at the front of their siege lines and another at the Four Mounds nearby[^1]. Xu Huang publicly declared that he would attack the former, but secretly struck the Four Mounds. Seeing that the Four Mounds were about to fall, Guan Yu personally led out five thousand infantry and cavalry to give battle. Xu Huang defeated them and drove them back, then pursued them into the siege lines and broke them. Some enemy soldiers even threw themselves into the [[Mian River|/maps/map-overall?water=51]] and drowned.

footnotes.en: Yanglingbei, Yancheng, and Four Mounds were all located north of [[Xiangyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.00162374&lng=112.14985623&name=襄陽]], near [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]].

orig.zht: 太祖令曰：「賊圍塹鹿角十重，將軍致戰全勝，遂陷賊圍，多斬首虜。吾用兵三十餘年，及所聞古之善用兵者，未有長驅徑入敵圍者也。且[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]之在圍，過於[[莒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.58381856&lng=118.81351928&name=Ju]]、[[即墨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.7066027&lng=120.21513573&name=Jimo]]，將軍之功，踰孫武、穰苴。」晃振旅還[[摩陂|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.92967724&lng=113.38240652&name=Mo%20Lake]]，太祖迎晃七[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，置酒大會。太祖舉巵酒勸晃，且勞之曰：「全[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]，將軍之功也。」時諸軍皆集，太祖案行諸營，士卒咸離陣觀，而晃軍營整齊，將士駐陣不動。太祖歎曰：「徐將軍可謂有周亞夫之風矣。」
orig.zhs: 太祖令曰：「贼围堑鹿角十重，将军致战全胜，遂陷贼围，多斩首虏。吾用兵三十余年，及所闻古之善用兵者，未有长驱径入敌围者也。且[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]之在围，过于[[莒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.58381856&lng=118.81351928&name=Ju]]、[[即墨|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.7066027&lng=120.21513573&name=Jimo]]，将军之功，逾孙武、穰苴。」晃振旅还[[摩陂|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.92967724&lng=113.38240652&name=Mo%20Lake]]，太祖迎晃七[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，置酒大会。太祖举巵酒劝晃，且劳之曰：「全[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]，将军之功也。」时诸军皆集，太祖案行诸营，士卒咸离阵观，而晃军营整齐，将士驻阵不动。太祖叹曰：「徐将军可谓有周亚夫之风矣。」

vern.zht: 太祖下令說：“敵人用壕溝和鹿角構築了十重包圍，將軍交戰獲得全勝，隨即攻破敵人包圍圈，斬殺和俘獲了大量敵人。我用兵三十多年，加上我所聽說過的古代善於用兵的人，沒有一個能長驅直入衝進敵人包圍圈的。況且[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]被圍的嚴重程度，超過了[[莒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.58381856&lng=118.81351928&name=Ju]]、[[即墨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.7066027&lng=120.21513573&name=Jimo]]，將軍的功勞，也超過了孫武、穰苴。”徐晃整頓軍隊返回[[摩陂|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.92967724&lng=113.38240652&name=Mo%20Lake]]，太祖出迎七[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，設酒宴舉行大會。太祖舉起酒杯向徐晃勸酒，並慰勞他說：“保全[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]，是將軍的功勞。”當時各軍都已集結，太祖巡視各營，士兵們都離開陣列觀看，而徐晃的軍營整齊，將士站在陣列中不動。太祖感嘆說：“徐將軍可以說有周亞夫的風範了。”
vern.zhs: 太祖下令说：“敌人用壕沟和鹿角构筑了十重包围，将军交战获得全胜，随即攻破敌人包围圈，斩杀和俘获了大量敌人。我用兵三十多年，加上我所听说过的古代善于用兵的人，没有一个能长驱直入冲进敌人包围圈的。况且[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]被围的严重程度，超过了[[莒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.58381856&lng=118.81351928&name=Ju]]、[[即墨|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.7066027&lng=120.21513573&name=Jimo]]，将军的功劳，也超过了孙武、穰苴。”徐晃整顿军队返回[[摩陂|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.92967724&lng=113.38240652&name=Mo%20Lake]]，太祖出迎七[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，设酒宴举行大会。太祖举起酒杯向徐晃劝酒，并慰劳他说：“保全[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]、[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]，是将军的功劳。”当时各军都已集结，太祖巡视各营，士兵们都离开阵列观看，而徐晃的军营整齐，将士站在阵列中不动。太祖感叹说：“徐将军可以说有周亚夫的风范了。”

passages.en: Cao Cao issued an order: "The rebels were protected by ten lines of trenches and abatis. You, General, engaged them and won a complete victory, then broke through their encirclement, killing and capturing many. In more than thirty years of commanding armies, and from all I have heard of the great commanders of antiquity, never have I known anyone drive straight into an enemy encirclement. Moreover, [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] and [[Xiangyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=89]] were in greater peril than [[Ju|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.58381856&lng=118.81351928&name=Ju]] and [[Jimo|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.7066027&lng=120.21513573&name=Jimo]] when under siege. Your achievement, General, surpasses those of Sun Wu and Rangju." Xu Huang returned in triumph to [[Mo Lake|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.92967724&lng=113.38240652&name=Mo%20Lake]]. Cao Cao went seven [[Li|/translations/officials#glossary-li]] out to meet him and held a great banquet. Raising a goblet, he urged Huang to drink and commended him: "[[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] and [[Xiangyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=89]] were saved because of your achievement, General!" Later, when all the armies had assembled, Cao Cao inspected each camp, and the soldiers left their ranks to watch him pass. Xu Huang's camp alone remained orderly, its officers and men standing motionless in formation. Cao Cao exclaimed, "General Xu may truly be said to possess the spirit of Zhou Yafu."

orig.zht: 文帝即王位，以晃為[[右將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-117]]，進封逯[[鄉侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]。及踐阼，進封[[楊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]侯。與夏侯尚討劉備於[[上庸|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.19396731&lng=110.13295836&name=Shangyong]]，破之。以晃鎮[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，徙封陽平侯。明帝即位，拒吳將諸葛瑾於[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]。增邑二百，并前三千一百戶。病篤，遺令歛以時服。
orig.zhs: 文帝即王位，以晃为[[右将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-117]]，进封逯[[乡侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]。及践阼，进封[[杨|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]侯。与夏侯尚讨刘备于[[上庸|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.19396731&lng=110.13295836&name=Shangyong]]，破之。以晃镇[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]，徙封阳平侯。明帝即位，拒吴将诸葛瑾于[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]。增邑二百，并前三千一百户。病笃，遗令歛以时服。

vern.zht: 文帝登上王位，任命徐晃爲[[右將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-117]]，進封爲逯[[鄉侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]。等到文帝登上帝位，又進封徐晃爲[[楊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]侯。徐晃與夏侯尚在[[上庸|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.19396731&lng=110.13295836&name=Shangyong]]討伐劉備，將他擊敗。文帝因徐晃鎮守[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]關，改封他爲[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]侯。明帝即位後，徐晃在[[襄陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]抵禦吳將諸葛瑾。徐晃的食邑增加二百戶，連同以前的共三千一百戶。徐晃病重，留下遺命，用與時令相稱的平常衣服入殮。
vern.zhs: 文帝登上王位，任命徐晃为[[右将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-117]]，进封为逯[[乡侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]。等到文帝登上帝位，又进封徐晃为[[杨|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]侯。徐晃与夏侯尚在[[上庸|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.19396731&lng=110.13295836&name=Shangyong]]讨伐刘备，将他击败。文帝因徐晃镇守[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]关，改封他为[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]]侯。明帝即位后，徐晃在[[襄阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]抵御吴将诸葛瑾。徐晃的食邑增加二百户，连同以前的共三千一百户。徐晃病重，留下遗命，用与时令相称的平常衣服入殓。

passages.en: When Emperor Wen (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) succeeded as King of Wei, he appointed Xu Huang [[General of the Right|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-117]] and advanced him to [[Township Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]] of Lu. After ascending the imperial throne, the emperor made him Marquis of [[Yang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.19189797&lng=111.75657765&name=Yang]]. Xu Huang later joined Xiahou Shang in attacking Liu Bei at [[Shangyong|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.19396731&lng=110.13295836&name=Shangyong]] and defeated him. As Xu Huang had formerly been stationed at [[Yangpingguan|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.16854232&lng=106.61155724&name=Yangpingguan]], he was transferred to become Marquis of Yangping. When Cao Rui (posthumously honoured as Emperor Ming, the Radiant Emperor) came to the throne, Xu Huang repelled the Wu general Zhuge Jin at [[Xiangyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=89]]. His fief was increased by two hundred households, bringing the total to 3100. When gravely ill, he left instructions that he be dressed for burial in ordinary clothes.

orig.zht: 性儉約畏慎，將軍常遠斥候，先為不可勝，然後戰，追奔爭利，士不暇食。常歎曰：「古人患不遭明君，今幸遇之，常以功自效，何用私譽為！」終不廣交援。太和元年薨，謚曰壯侯。子蓋嗣。蓋薨，子霸嗣。明帝分晃戶，封晃子孫二人[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。
orig.zhs: 性俭约畏慎，将军常远斥候，先为不可胜，然后战，追奔争利，士不暇食。常叹曰：「古人患不遭明君，今幸遇之，常以功自效，何用私誉为！」终不广交援。太和元年薨，谥曰壮侯。子盖嗣。盖薨，子霸嗣。明帝分晃户，封晃子孙二人[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。

vern.zht: 徐晃生性節儉謹慎，擔任將軍時常常遠遠派出偵察兵，先使自己處於不可戰勝的態勢，然後才交戰；乘勝追擊、爭奪戰利時，將士們常常顧不上喫飯。他常感嘆說：“古人擔心遇不上明君，如今我有幸遇到了，常以戰功報效，哪裏用得着個人的聲譽呢！”他始終不廣交朋友、攀附關係。太和元年去世，諡號爲壯侯。兒子徐蓋繼承爵位。徐蓋去世，兒子徐霸繼承爵位。明帝分出徐晃的封邑戶數，封徐晃的子孫二人爲[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。
vern.zhs: 徐晃生性节俭谨慎，担任将军时常常远远派出侦察兵，先使自己处于不可战胜的态势，然后才交战；乘胜追击、争夺战利时，将士们常常顾不上吃饭。他常感叹说：“古人担心遇不上明君，如今我有幸遇到了，常以战功报效，哪里用得着个人的声誉呢！”他始终不广交朋友、攀附关系。太和元年去世，谥号为壮侯。儿子徐盖继承爵位。徐盖去世，儿子徐霸继承爵位。明帝分出徐晃的封邑户数，封徐晃的子孙二人为[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。

passages.en: Xu Huang was frugal and cautious by nature, and when commanding an army always sent scouts far afield, first ensuring that he could not be defeated before giving battle. In pursuing a routed enemy or pressing for an advantage, his men had no time even to eat. He often sighed, "The men of old lamented that they did not encounter an enlightened lord. Now that I have had the good fortune to meet one, I should prove myself through achievement. What need have I of personal renown?" To the end, he never cultivated a wide circle of allies. Xu Huang died in the first year of Taihe and was posthumously titled [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]] Zhuang, the Valiant Marquis. His son Xu Gai succeeded him. When Xu Gai died, his son Xu Ba succeeded him. Cao Rui later divided the households of Xu Huang's fief and granted two of his descendants the title of Marquis.

orig.zht: 初，[[清河|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]]朱靈為袁紹將。太祖之征陶謙，紹使靈督三營助太祖，戰有功。紹所遣諸將各罷歸，靈曰：「靈觀人多矣，無若曹公者，此乃真明主也。今以遇，復何之？」遂留不去。所將士卒慕之，皆隨靈留。靈後遂為好將，名亞晃等，至[[後將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]，封高唐[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。
orig.zhs: 初，[[清河|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]]朱灵为袁绍将。太祖之征陶谦，绍使灵督三营助太祖，战有功。绍所遣诸将各罢归，灵曰：「灵观人多矣，无若曹公者，此乃真明主也。今以遇，复何之？」遂留不去。所将士卒慕之，皆随灵留。灵后遂为好将，名亚晃等，至[[后将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]，封高唐[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。

vern.zht: 當初，[[清河|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]]人朱靈是袁紹的部將。太祖征討陶謙時，袁紹派朱靈督領三營協助太祖，作戰有功。袁紹派來的衆將都各自撤了回去。朱靈說：“我看過的人很多，沒有比得上曹公的，這真是英明的主上啊。如今已經遇到了，還要到哪裏去呢？”於是留下不再離開。他率領的士兵仰慕太祖，都跟着朱靈留下。朱靈後來成爲良將，名聲僅次於徐晃等人，官至[[後將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]，封爲高唐[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。
vern.zhs: 当初，[[清河|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]]人朱灵是袁绍的部将。太祖征讨陶谦时，袁绍派朱灵督领三营协助太祖，作战有功。袁绍派来的众将都各自撤了回去。朱灵说：“我看过的人很多，没有比得上曹公的，这真是英明的主上啊。如今已经遇到了，还要到哪里去呢？”于是留下不再离开。他率领的士兵仰慕太祖，都跟着朱灵留下。朱灵后来成为良将，名声仅次于徐晃等人，官至[[后将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]，封为高唐[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。

passages.en: Initially, Zhu Ling of [[Qinghe|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]] served as a general under Yuan Shao. When Cao Cao campaigned against Tao Qian, Yuan Shao sent Zhu Ling to command three encampments in his support, and Zhu Ling earned merit in battle. When Yuan Shao's other generals returned, Zhu Ling said, "I have observed many men, but none compares with Lord Cao. He is truly an enlightened lord. Now that I have found him, where else should I go?" He therefore remained. The soldiers under his command admired him, and all stayed with him. Zhu Ling later became an able general, his reputation second only to Xu Huang and his peers. He rose to [[General of the Rear|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]] and was enfeoffed as [[Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]] of Gaotang.

annotations.en: The Annals of the Nine Provinces states: At first, Ji Yong of [[Qinghe|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]] rebelled against Yuan Shao at [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.99635407&lng=116.31260117&name=Shu]] and surrendered to Gongsun Zan; Gongsun Zan sent troops to defend him. Yuan Shao sent Zhu Ling to attack the city. Gongsun Zan had Zhu Ling's mother and younger brother placed on the city wall to call out to him, hoping to sway him. Looking towards the city, Zhu Ling wept and said, "Once a man has pledged himself to another, how can he still think of his family?" He then fought with all his strength and took the city, capturing Yong alive, though his entire family perished.

《魏書》曰：靈字文博。太祖旣平[[兾州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]，遣靈將新兵五千人騎千匹守[[許|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]南。太祖戒之曰：「[[兾州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]新兵，數承寬緩，暫見齊整，意尚怏怏。卿名先有威嚴，善以道寬之，不然即有變。」靈至[[陽翟|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.14679273&lng=113.48608338&name=Yangdi]]，中郎將程昂等果反，即斬昂，以狀聞。太祖手書曰：「兵中所以為危險者，外對敵國，內有姦謀不測之變。昔鄧禹中分光武軍西行，而有宗歆、馮愔之難，後將二十四騎還洛陽，禹豈以是減損哉？來書懇惻，多引咎過，未必如所云也。」

文帝即位，封靈[[鄃|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.99635407&lng=116.31260117&name=Shu]]侯，增其戶邑。詔曰：「將軍佐命先帝，典兵歷年，威過方、邵，功踰絳、灌。圖籍所美，何以加焉？朕受天命，帝有海內，元功之將，社稷之臣，皆朕所與同福共慶，傳之無窮者也。今封[[鄃|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.99635407&lng=116.31260117&name=Shu]]侯。富貴不歸故鄉，如夜行衣繡。若平常所志，願勿難言。」靈謝曰：「[[高唐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88585045&lng=116.44565861&name=Gaotang]]，宿所願。」於是更封[[高唐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88585045&lng=116.44565861&name=Gaotang]]侯，薨，謚曰威侯。子術嗣。

The Book of Wei states: Zhu Ling's courtesy name was Wenbo. After Cao Cao had pacified [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]], he sent Zhu Ling with five thousand new troops and a thousand horsemen to garrison south of [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]. Cao Cao warned him, "The new troops from [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]] have repeatedly been treated with leniency. Though they appear disciplined for now, they remain defiant at heart. You already have a reputation for severity, so manage them wisely and temper your strictness with clemency. Otherwise, they will mutiny." When Zhu Ling reached [[Yangdi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.14679273&lng=113.48608338&name=Yangdi]], Gentleman-General Cheng Ang and others did indeed rebel. Zhu Ling promptly beheaded Cheng Ang and reported the circumstances. Cao Cao wrote to him personally: "What makes an army's position perilous is to face an enemy state while having unforeseen treachery within. In former times, Deng Yu led half of Emperor Guangwu's army westward, only for Zong Xin and Feng Yin to rebel. He later returned to Luoyang with just twenty-four horsemen. Did this diminish Deng Yu? Your letter is earnest and remorseful, and you repeatedly take the blame upon yourself, but matters may not be as you say." 

When Cao Pi ascended the throne, he enfeoffed Zhu Ling as Marquis of [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.99635407&lng=116.31260117&name=Shu]] and enlarged his fief. His edict declared: "General, you aided the Former Emperor in securing the Mandate and commanded troops for many years. Your authority surpassed that of Fang Shu and Shao Hu, and your achievements exceeded those of the Marquis of Jiang and Guan Ying. How could the praises recorded in the histories add to this? I have received Heaven's Mandate and rule all within the seas. Commanders of foremost merit and ministers who uphold the state are those with whom I share good fortune and celebration, and whose honours shall be transmitted without end. I now enfeoff you as Marquis of [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.99635407&lng=116.31260117&name=Shu]]. Yet to enjoy wealth and honour without returning to one's native place is like wearing embroidered robes by night. If there is somewhere you have long wished for, do not hesitate to say so." Zhu Ling replied in thanks, "[[Gaotang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88585045&lng=116.44565861&name=Gaotang]] has long been my wish." He was then accordingly re-enfeoffed as Marquis of [[Gaotang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88585045&lng=116.44565861&name=Gaotang]]. After his death, he received the posthumous title Marquis Wei, the Formidable Marquis. His son Zhu Shu succeeded him.
